name: flexviz
description: Explore large local Parquet/CSV files as live interactive dashboards, and read back the zooms and selections the human makes.

interface.shortDescription: Interactive dashboards over large local datasets
interface.longDescription: Serve a Parquet or CSV file as a live cross-filter dashboard the human explores in their browser. The data stays in a lazy Polars query engine; only bounded aggregates reach the browser, and the agent reads back the exact viewport and selections.
defaultPrompt: Explore readings.parquet as an interactive dashboard.
What did I just select on the dashboard?
Build a cross-filter view of this dataset.
